lines.line: Digital clinical thermometer — underarm/oral, flexible tip
lines.note: Three real thermometer SKUs (Hicks, 2x Cipla) sit in Medicare with zero sales, zero stock and no purchase date ever.
Only plain contact thermometers are listed (all dead); no non-contact IR device.
Hicks is the classic glass brand; listed but never sold or purchased.

lines.line: Automatic upper-arm BP monitor — entry level
lines.note: Candidates were all Orion Chocopie / Trust sugar noise; no BP device of any kind.

lines.line: Automatic upper-arm BP monitor — premium / app-connected

lines.note: Every 'gluco' hit is glucose biscuits or Glucon-D powder — no meter.
'Strip' hits are melon strips, wax strips and a power strip.
Every 'scale' in the catalogue is a stationery ruler.
'Clearblue' matches were all Clean & Clear face wash.

lines.line: Nebuliser mask / tube / medicine-cup replacement kit
lines.note: Only cloth/beauty masks exist; no nebuliser consumables.

lines.line: Electric steam inhaler / vaporiser + inhalant capsules
lines.note: Vicks inhalant sells well (q148); the steam vaporiser side is one unit of Liza Steamer, other vaporisers dead.

lines.line: Asthma support — inhaler spacer / holding chamber and peak flow meter
lines.note: Cipla hits are dead thermometers and a linseed gel.

lines.line: Adhesive bandages (band-aids) — plain, washproof, and kids' printed
lines.note: One generic Dettol Bandaid SKU carries the whole line — q1824, stk1041; no washproof or printed variants.
Only small packs move; the 550 ml (08QV) is dead and shows negative stock — no 1L/5L institutional pack.

lines.line: Antiseptic and antibiotic skin cream / ointment
lines.note: Antiseptic creams only (Boroline/Himalaya/Boro Plus); no antibiotic ointment — Soframycin/Betadine absent.

lines.searched: betadine, povidone, cipladine, peroxide, swab, rectified
lines.note: 'Spirit' hits are Sprite and Engage deo; Dettol antiseptic liquid belongs to line 19, not povidone/spirit/peroxide.
Cotton balls and one roll SKU, all Medicare, all now at zero stock with no recorded purchase.
All 'pads' candidates are sanitary napkins.
'Roll' hits are toilet rolls and roller pens.
'Elastic' is sewing elastic tape; 'crepe' is Nivea creme and biscuit cremes.

lines.line: Adhesive tape — micropore and zinc oxide plaster
lines.note: Only cello/stationery tape; no medical tape.
'Dressing' hits are salad dressings and kids' dress sets.

lines.line: Assembled first aid kit — home, vehicle, and wall-mounted
lines.note: No kit SKU; the components themselves are also mostly absent, so ARY cannot yet self-assemble one.

lines.line: Barrier protection — disposable gloves and face masks
lines.note: Only a reusable cotton face mask (q100, now stk0); every 'glove' listed is a woollen winter glove, no medical gloves.

lines.line: First aid instruments and CPR barrier
lines.note: Safety pins listed with stk39 but zero sales; scissors on file are stationery, not first-aid shears; no tweezers or CPR shield.

lines.line: Sterile eye wash, saline and eye pads
lines.note: Only a dead ayurvedic eye drop (06Z1); no sterile saline or eye pads.
Ready-to-drink bottles only — no ORS sachets and no zinc dispersible tablets.

lines.searched: ice pack, cold pack, gel pack
gel pack, hot pack, cold pack
lines.note: 'Cold' hits are cold coffee, cold-press oil and cold cream.

lines.line: Hot water bag — rubber and electric
lines.searched: hot water bag, rubber bag, warmer
lines.note: One rubber bag SKU, q38 and stk12, but last purchased Dec-2025 — no electric version.
Only a dead 'Heating Sheet' (bed warmer, Electricals), not a therapeutic heating pad or belt.
Single unbranded Knee Cap SKU, q45 and stk33, last bought Oct-2025 — no size run.

lines.line: Joint and limb supports — ankle binder, wrist splint, elbow support, finger splint
lines.searched: ankle, elbow, splint, wrist band, tynor
lines.note: Only a dead sports Wrist Band (05HZ, Toy & Sports), not a wrist splint.
'Collar' matches Coca Cola.
Apollo/Life Style belts are clothing belts (~Rs186 each), not orthopaedic supports.
'Sling' hits are sling bags.
'Binder' hits are Kinder Joy and a stationery binder clip.

lines.line: Walking stick — single-point, L-shape, tripod and quadripod
lines.note: 'Stick' hits are file sticks, drumsticks and dhoop sticks.
'Crutches' matched a Cremica coconut-crunch biscuit.
'Wheelchair' matched Wheel detergent powder.

lines.line: Bed-care items — commode chair, bedpan, urinal pot, anti-bedsore air mattress
lines.note: Mattresses listed are ordinary bedding, not anti-bedsore air mattresses.

lines.line: Infant dosing aids — oral syringe, dropper, measuring cup
lines.note: Only milk feeder bottles — a feeding bottle is not an oral dosing syringe.

lines.line: Baby nasal care — aspirator and saline drops
lines.best_match: Gsk Ortivin Nosal Spray 10 Ml Saline
lines.note: The saline variant is listed but never sold; the paediatric decongestant spray (0BL8) sold 6 units. No aspirator.
Only token sales (q5, stk1); the whole Dettol/Savlon/Himalaya/W2 sanitizer range behind it is dead.

lines.line: Hearing aid amplifier and zinc-air button cells
lines.note: AA/AAA cells exist (line 56) but no zinc-air hearing-aid cells or amplifier.
Every 'glass' hit is drinkware.

lines.line: Device batteries — AA, AAA, CR2032 and button cells
lines.note: Strong AA/AAA business (q1723 + q660) but no CR2032 or LR41/LR44 button cells at all.

lines.line: Clinic-grade consumables for the campus infirmary and hospital
lines.note: 'Dispovan/disposable' matches are disposable plates, glasses and straws.
